title: M2b.1 evaluation-only control: original vs cleaned (all pixels) vs cleaned with predicted exclusions on the E004 comparisons
approval: Owner approval 16 November 2026: evaluation-only original-image control on the existing Mendeley dataset, solely to measure the effect of cleaning and masking. Not a product path; product queries always pass through stamp removal.
claim_limit: Genuine signatures and random impostors only; no skilled-forgery, stamp-robustness or authenticity-accuracy claim. Diagnostic on development/validation data already examined in E004; final test not scored.

arms.A: evaluation-only original-image control: original query, padding exclusion only, no cleaner

threshold_rule: each arm: its own development EER threshold under the same rule, applied unchanged to validation
